overview_description.description:
Kuwait Financial Centre 'Markaz' was established in 1974, and has become one of the leading asset management and investment banking institutions in the Arab region. The company was listed on Boursa Kuwait (Formerly known as Kuwait Stock Exchange (KSE)) in 1997.

Markaz offers full fledged services in asset management and investment banking. Asset management services offered by the company include Investment Advisory Services, GCC & International Investments and Private Equities. Markaz's Assets Under Management (AUM) as of 30th June, 2017 is KD 960 million ( USD 3.17 Billion)

Tested through challenging conditions on local, GCC and international stock markets for many years now, Markaz Asset Management activity has consistently outperformed the relevant benchmarks on its equity funds and managed portfolios. Markaz has earned a credible name for itself amongst the top performing fund managers in Kuwait due to this strong and consistent performance spanning many years. The support of a qualified research team of experienced finance professionals helps the investment managers set their investment strategies. In an effort to focus on meeting client investment needs, Markaz introduced the first options trading platform in the Middle East by issuing and selling derivative instruments (Call options) on Boursa Kuwait listed stocks.

Investment Advisory Services offer Markaz clients tailor-made investment solutions to meet their financial objectives, supported by efficient employment of in-depth market due diligence and constant monitoring. Full transparency is delivered by monthly reports and quarterly reviews. Each dedicated portfolio advisor is trained to identify the right investment opportunities that adhere to three key elements: diversification, reliance on fundamentals and anticipation of future trends.

about_short_description.short_description: Kuwait Financial Centre is an investment company offering asset management and investment banking.

product.name: Asset Management
product.description: Investment management across proprietary and customized funds and portfolios, using quantitative and qualitative analysis across equities, fixed income, real estate and other asset classes.

product.name: Investment Banking
product.description: Corporate finance and transaction services covering equity and debt issuance, IPOs, listings, mergers and acquisitions, restructuring, capital structure and financial advisory.

product.name: Real Estate Investment
product.description: Investment, fund management and portfolio services for income-generating and development properties across MENA, the United States and Europe.

product.name: Wealth Management
product.description: Personalized investment planning and advisory across equities, fixed income, currencies, commodities, real estate, alternative investments and structured products.

product.name: Research and Consulting Services
product.description: MENA-focused economic, industry, infrastructure, capital-markets, policy and regulatory research, supplemented by customized consulting and business analysis.

product.name: Fixed Income Investment Services
product.description: Advisory, portfolio management and custody services for bonds, sukuk and other fixed-income instruments in MENA, emerging markets and global markets.
